\[
I_{\text{out}} = \begin{cases} I & I < t \\ 255 - I & I \ge t \end{cases},
\qquad t = 128
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input value from 0 to 255
- \(t\): The threshold

Values below the threshold stay. Values at or above it are mirrored, as in the image negative. This is the rule of Pillow's ImageOps.solarize. In film photography, solarization and the Sabattier effect reverse tones by overexposure or by a second exposure during development. This filter only imitates the look.
